responsibility: Defines the AVX10.2-512 conversion intrinsic header for 512-bit FP16/BF8/HF8 and related narrow-format conversions. This file owns the full-width APIs that combine two packed FP32 vectors into packed FP16, convert FP16 to and from BF8/HF8 encodings, and handle biased or signed conversion variants, exposing masked and rounding-controlled wrappers around the corresponding AVX10.2-512 builtins.
